about.title: Owned by Jeremiah and Lexie White
paragraphs: Red Beard Concrete is owned and operated by Jeremiah and Lexie White. But the newcomer, Jericho, is the real boss.
Red Beard's diverse and experienced team put their heart and soul into each job to ensure high quality concrete services no matter what.

We specialize in all styles and types of concrete work. As a licensed general contractor, we also provide construction and remodeling services to handle projects from start to finish. Inquiries are always welcome!
